title: PHP Code Snippet to Check If a Member/User is Logged In | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: PHP Code Snippet to Check If a Member/User is Logged In Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000095724 The code snippet below will determine if members are currently logged into their accounts on the website. <?php // Check if the user is not logged in if (user::isUserLogged($_COOKIE)) { ?> TEXT TO DISPLAY WHEN MEMBER LOGGED IN <?php } ?> Replace " TEXT TO DISPLAY WHEN MEMBER LOGGED IN " with your desired content. This content will be displayed only when a user is logged in. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
